text: Code reviews are an essential practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged. Their main benefit is catching bugs early, which saves time and money compared to fixing issues after release. Beyond finding errors, reviews promote knowledge sharing, as less experienced developers learn from senior colleagues and everyone stays updated on different parts of the project. This process also improves team quality by encouraging consistent coding standards and clearer communication. When people know their work will be reviewed, they write more carefully, and constructive feedback builds trust. Ultimately, code reviews create a collaborative culture where the whole team delivers better software.
